definition: bits = mean over training restarts 0-1 of the held-out rate (trained prior; bits per sample, an upper bound on the information the code carries) at which the cell reaches output nMSE eps, linear interpolation in nMSE between evaluated points (achievable by time-sharing); slope = bits per halving of the output RMS error; flags = certificate statuses (PREREG P1, A4 rules); certified = every applicable certificate ran and passed. Local cells: bits = the reference start (base), bits_h1 = the one-layer look-ahead start (A3/A7/A10), bits_class = the better of the two (the count to use; an upper bound for the class). Status "h1 start only" = the base cell has not run; "not run (A8 reduced plan)" = outside the reduced plan. Base restarts: 0-1 at ARC layers 0 (unrestricted), 31 and the output, narrow-deep everywhere; restart 0 at the other ARC cells (A8). extra_runs: the certificate and added runs of a cell (restart 2, 2x/4x steps, 2x depth, depth 6 with 4x steps, 10x encoder learning rate), bits at each eps; they show how far the base count may still fall; bits_best_known = the lowest bits over every run of the cell (base, both starts, extra runs), the tightest upper bound found.
